figurative_meaning_en: Straightforward; without any twists or deceit
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা সোজা সাপটা, কোনো মিথ্যে নেই।
এই ব্যবসা সোজা সাপটা, কোনো জটিলতা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: His words are straight as a snake, no lies in them.
This business is straightforward, no complications involved.
note: The idiom draws from the image of a snake moving in a straight line, symbolizing simplicity and lack of cunning.
